method: Country-specific piecewise annual history grounded in early territorial tennis, post-independence competition continuity, transition-era constraints and strictly gated current infrastructure/development evidence.
evidence_rules: Pre-1991 ratings describe tennis on current Kazakhstan territory within Soviet governance and never inherit USSR-wide counts or outcomes.
1933/1935 Almaty/Dynamo history supports tradition and limited competition context, not national participation.
1990s/2000s underfunding is qualitative constraint evidence, not an annual funding series.
President's Cup continuity and 2007 Challenger status measure organised competition opportunity, not player quality.
2026 branches, programmes, centres and courts are current-only and are not backcast.
9+ remains reserved for clearly world-leading dimensions; modern structural investment alone is insufficient.
